title.value: Bugs in the Data: How ImageNet Misrepresents Biodiversity
title.justification: The paper focuses on analyzing the wildlife-related data in ImageNet-1k and how it misrepresents biodiversity.
title.quote: Bugs in the Data: How ImageNet Misrepresents Biodiversity

extractions.description: The paper analyzes the representation of biodiversity in the ImageNet-1k dataset, identifying significant biases, inaccuracies, and geographical misrepresentations in the dataset's wildlife classes. It involves input from expert ecologists to validate class definitions and image accuracy. It addresses issues of incorrect labeling, class overlap, geographical and cultural biases, and the implications for ML models trained using this data.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: Biodiversity and its accurate representation are central topics of the paper, focusing on how ImageNet-1k misrepresents them, which impacts ML tasks related to ecology and biodiversity.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Our findings highlight serious issues... the ways in which ML datasets are commonly created and curated.

primary_category.justification: The paper's primary focus is on how biodiversity is represented in ImageNet-1k, which directly relates to Natural Systems Protection.
primary_category.quote: The goal of our work is to quantify the extent to which the natural world, namely wildlife, is under- and mis-represented in ImageNet-1k.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not focus on other areas beyond biodiversity and its representation in ML datasets, hence no secondary categories are applicable.
